summary.text: Misty Flowers is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 42-Position 1, facing Democratic incumbent Alicia Rule in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website says she is running to bring accountability, transparency and fiscal responsibility to the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Flowers advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 43.7 percent of the vote to Rule's 56.3 percent.

Her campaign website lists goals that include responsibly lowering property, sales and state income taxes, aligning local building codes with state standards to expand housing, and expanding jail capacity for violent offenders alongside addiction recovery programs.
It also calls for simplified permitting and investment in marine trades, tourism, agriculture and expanded ferry service to support workforce development.
